name: Estimator-agreement side
hypothesis: When the two independent estimators land within 3 points of each other, the originated spread is measuring a real gap rather than estimator noise, so the side is worth taking; when they disagree, the spread is not.
universe: every game in the rolling window (up to three days ahead) with both estimators available
rule: take the home side to cover the originated spread when the two margins have the same sign and their disagreement is <= 3.0 points; otherwise no bet
refusals: no bet if either club's luck z-score is outside +-1.96 (noise band)
no bet if the official injury report has not been filed for that game date
no bet if the game's rotation minutes are unmeasurable for BOTH clubs and the disagreement is above 1.0 point
settlement: home covers when (home_pts - away_pts) > (-blend_margin); a push (exactly equal) settles as a loss. Settled from the official final score.
status: frozen — not eligible for publication until it clears its gates
